Our mission is to deliver exceptional non-emergency medical transportation services through reliability, safety, and compassionate care. We strive to build lasting partnerships with healthcare providers, facilities, and communities while ensuring every passenger receives respectful and dependable transportation.

OUR SERVICE AREA

Care across
Dallas–Fort Worth.

Compassion Care Transport provides non-emergency medical transportation in the Dallas–Fort Worth area for ambulatory and wheelchair passengers, medical appointments, ongoing care and hospital discharge journeys.

Pickup and drop-off can be arranged at hospitals, nursing homes, doctors’ offices, clinics and homes. Share both addresses so the team can confirm trip availability, vehicle suitability and assistance arrangements.

Ambulatory transportationA little support. More independence.Explore this service +

Transportation for passengers who walk independently or use a cane or walker.

Share any walking aids, steps or boarding assistance needs when requesting a ride. The team can then confirm whether the vehicle and available support fit your trip.

UNDERSTAND YOUR RIDE

Who this is for

For passengers who can travel seated and walk independently or with a cane, walker or agreed assistance.

How the journey is planned

Ambulatory describes the passenger’s mobility, rather than the reason for the appointment. Planning focuses on getting to the vehicle, boarding, storing walking aids and reaching the destination entrance. Tell us about the help you actually need so the team can check that the trip is suitable.

What we plan with you

  • A planned pickup and destination
  • Review of walking aids and boarding needs
  • Arrival timing and any return-trip request

Have these details ready

  • Cane, walker or other walking aid
  • Steps, uneven paths and entrance access
  • Required arrival time and return plan

Questions about this service

Is ambulatory transportation the same as wheelchair transportation?

No. Ambulatory transport is planned for someone who can walk and board with the agreed assistance. A passenger who needs to remain in a wheelchair requires a different vehicle arrangement.

Will someone help me inside the building?

Describe the assistance you need at both ends. Curbside, doorway and inside-building support are different arrangements; the team must confirm which help is available.

Our team confirms pickup timing, vehicle suitability, assistance and return arrangements before accepting a ride.

Wheelchair transportationYour mobility. Our attention.Explore this service +

Accessible transportation arranged around your wheelchair and assistance needs.

Include your wheelchair type, pickup access and any assistance requirements. The team must confirm vehicle compatibility and pickup arrangements before accepting the ride.

UNDERSTAND YOUR RIDE

Who this is for

For passengers whose trip requires wheelchair access and a vehicle compatible with their chair and assistance needs.

How the journey is planned

Wheelchair transportation planning covers more than vehicle space. The team needs to review the chair, boarding access and how the wheelchair and passenger will be secured. A power chair, scooter, wider chair or difficult entrance needs advance discussion; suitability is confirmed for the individual trip.

What we plan with you

  • Review of chair and vehicle compatibility
  • Access planning at pickup and destination
  • Boarding and securement arrangements

Have these details ready

  • Manual chair, power chair or scooter type
  • Chair dimensions and combined weight if requested
  • Ramps, elevators, stairs and doorway access

Questions about this service

Can I stay in my wheelchair during the ride?

Tell the team that you need to remain seated in your chair. They must confirm the vehicle, chair compatibility and appropriate securement before accepting the trip.

Can the driver carry a wheelchair up stairs?

Do not assume stair carrying or lifting is included. Describe every step and access barrier in advance so the team can review an appropriate arrangement.

Our team confirms pickup timing, vehicle suitability, assistance and return arrangements before accepting a ride.

Hospital dischargesThe next chapter starts at home.Explore this service +

Transportation from the hospital to home or an agreed care destination.

Coordinate your request with the discharge team. Share the expected ready time, destination, mobility needs and contact person; discharge readiness and ride availability must be confirmed.

UNDERSTAND YOUR RIDE

Who this is for

For a patient being released from a hospital to home or another agreed destination, with the transport type reviewed by the care team.

How the journey is planned

Discharge transport depends on when the patient is actually ready to leave. Coordinate the pickup entrance, ready time, mobility needs and receiving contact with the discharge planner or nurse. If travel needs change, tell both teams before the ride; transportation does not replace discharge instructions or clinical care.

What we plan with you

  • Coordination with the discharge contact
  • Confirmed pickup and receiving destination
  • Mobility and handoff planning

Have these details ready

  • Hospital entrance and discharge-team contact
  • Expected ready time, confirmed when released
  • Receiving person or facility and access details

Questions about this service

Can you pick up before the discharge is complete?

The hospital must confirm the patient is ready for the agreed transport. Share the estimated time early, then update the transportation team when discharge timing is confirmed.

What if the patient cannot sit upright?

Ask the discharge team which transport type is appropriate. Stretcher transport and clinical monitoring are not among Compassion Care’s confirmed services; do not assume a standard ride will meet those needs.

Our team confirms pickup timing, vehicle suitability, assistance and return arrangements before accepting a ride.

Doctor appointmentsMake room for your health.Explore this service +

Non-emergency rides to scheduled medical visits and outpatient appointments.

Provide the time you need to arrive, not just the appointment start time. Discuss return transportation and any companion or mobility needs when requesting your trip.

UNDERSTAND YOUR RIDE

Who this is for

For a scheduled, non-emergency medical or outpatient visit when a passenger needs transportation assistance.

How the journey is planned

A successful appointment trip starts with the clinic’s required arrival time, which may be earlier than the appointment itself. Provide the correct building and entrance, boarding needs and whether someone will accompany the passenger. Discuss the return separately, especially when the length of the appointment is uncertain.

What we plan with you

  • Planning around the required arrival time
  • Review of clinic access and mobility needs
  • One-way or requested return coordination

Have these details ready

  • Clinic name, address and entrance
  • Required check-in time
  • Return estimate and companion request

Questions about this service

Will the driver wait during my appointment?

Ask when requesting the trip. A scheduled return, a call-when-ready pickup and a driver waiting on site are different arrangements; waiting availability and charges require team confirmation.

Can I use this after sedation?

Ask the clinic what escort and discharge arrangements it requires. Transportation alone may not meet its responsible-adult policy; the clinic and transportation team must confirm the plan.

Our team confirms pickup timing, vehicle suitability, assistance and return arrangements before accepting a ride.

Dialysis transportationSupport for the routine that matters.Explore this service +

Transportation requests for dialysis visits, including recurring appointment schedules.

Share treatment days, arrival times and expected return arrangements. Each recurring schedule needs team confirmation; changes in appointment times or assistance needs should be communicated.

UNDERSTAND YOUR RIDE

Who this is for

For trips to dialysis appointments, including requests for a repeated schedule.

How the journey is planned

Dialysis transportation planning centers on a dependable appointment pattern and clear return arrangements. Share treatment days, required arrival and the center’s expected finish time. Tell the team about mobility or assistance needs for both legs, and report schedule changes promptly. Recurring rides still require confirmation of availability.

What we plan with you

  • Review of repeated appointment dates
  • Coordination of outward and return journeys
  • Updates when timing or mobility needs change

Have these details ready

  • Treatment days and required arrival times
  • Dialysis-center contact and entrance
  • Expected finish time and return contact

Questions about this service

Can the same weekly schedule be requested?

Yes. Share the full appointment pattern and assistance needs. The team must review the dates and confirm transportation; a recurring request does not reserve an unconfirmed vehicle.

What if treatment finishes late?

Notify the transportation team as soon as the timing changes. Agree in advance who will call when the passenger is ready and how the return will be coordinated.

Our team confirms pickup timing, vehicle suitability, assistance and return arrangements before accepting a ride.

Rehabilitation appointmentsKeep moving toward your goals.Explore this service +

Rides to physical therapy, rehabilitation and other scheduled recovery appointments.

Let the team know about walking aids, boarding needs and changes in mobility. Transportation supports getting to appointments; therapy and treatment remain with your healthcare professionals.

UNDERSTAND YOUR RIDE

Who this is for

For travel to physical therapy, rehabilitation and other scheduled recovery appointments.

How the journey is planned

Recovery needs can change between appointments. Tell the team what walking aids or wheelchair arrangements are needed now, rather than relying on a previous trip’s details. Include the therapy location, arrival time and return estimate. Transportation helps you reach treatment; exercise instructions and clinical decisions remain with the treating professionals.

What we plan with you

  • Planning around therapy appointments
  • Review of current mobility and access needs
  • Requests for repeated visits and returns

Have these details ready

  • Therapy dates, location and arrival times
  • Current walking aid or wheelchair needs
  • Changes in boarding ability or assistance

Questions about this service

Can I request transport for a course of therapy?

Yes. Provide the dates and expected appointment times so the team can review the full transportation request.

Does the driver provide rehabilitation treatment?

This is a transportation service. Therapy, transfers requiring clinical support and treatment instructions must be handled by the appropriate healthcare professionals.

Our team confirms pickup timing, vehicle suitability, assistance and return arrangements before accepting a ride.

Assisted living and nursing facility transportationCare continues between destinations.Explore this service +

Coordinated transportation for assisted living and nursing facility residents.

Facility staff or families can share resident transportation needs, pickup access, appointment details and the receiving contact. Confirm handoff responsibilities and return arrangements with the team.

UNDERSTAND YOUR RIDE

Who this is for

For assisted living and nursing facility residents whose family or care team is coordinating a non-emergency trip.

How the journey is planned

Facility transportation connects the resident, the sending facility and the receiving destination. Planning should identify who will have the resident ready, where the driver should meet them, and who will receive them after the trip. Confirm mobility needs, access arrangements and the return contact before transportation is accepted.

What we plan with you

  • Coordination with a family or facility contact
  • Resident mobility and pickup-access review
  • Sending and receiving handoff details

Have these details ready

  • Facility name, entrance and coordinating contact
  • Resident’s current mobility and assistance needs
  • Receiving contact and return arrangements

Questions about this service

Can facility staff request the ride?

Yes. A coordinator or family member can provide trip details. The team then reviews availability, assistance and handoff arrangements before confirming transportation.

Can a family member or caregiver come along?

Request companion space before booking. Seating, assistance responsibilities and any additional charges must be confirmed by the team.

Our team confirms pickup timing, vehicle suitability, assistance and return arrangements before accepting a ride.

Before your ride.

Where can passengers be picked up or dropped off?

Pickup and drop-off can be arranged at hospitals, nursing homes, doctors’ offices, clinics and homes in the Dallas–Fort Worth area. Share both addresses so the team can confirm trip availability and suitable assistance.

Where does Compassion Care Transport provide rides?

Compassion Care Transport serves the Dallas–Fort Worth area. Share your pickup and destination addresses so the team can confirm availability and suitable transportation for your trip.

What transportation services are available?

Ambulatory and wheelchair transportation, hospital discharge rides, doctor appointments, dialysis, rehabilitation, and assisted living or nursing facility transportation.

Can I request recurring transportation?

Share the appointment dates, arrival times and assistance needs so the team can review a recurring schedule.

Does submitting a request confirm my ride?

No. The team must confirm trip suitability, vehicle availability and pickup arrangements before a ride is booked.
